The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of ﬁxed point 8-bit multiplication can be a viable alternative to INT32 multiplication for quantization, leading to a signiﬁcant reduction of memory and energy footprint.
the use of only ﬁxed point multiplication can achieve competitive results compared to the full-precison counterparts, while being much cheaper in terms of memory and speed.
